040    /**
041     * Crée toutes les pièces, relie leurs sorties,
042     * crée le joueur et place les items dans les pièces.
043     */

045    {
046        String textMonster = "in a room with a horrifying monster";
047        String textKey     = "in a very messy room with a key in the center";
048
049        Room vStart   = new Room( "in the entrance of the submerged city", "Panorama.png" );
050        Room v2       = new Room( "in an empty street with beautiful buildings", "Road.png" );
051        Room v3       = new Room( "in the General Quarter, there is oxygen in this place", "Rest.png" );
052        Room v4       = new Room( textMonster, "Monster.png" );
053        Room v5       = new Room( "in a room with a chest in the center", "Chest.png" );
054        Room v6       = new Room( textMonster, "Monster2.png" );
055        Room v7       = new Room( textKey, "Key1.png" );
056        Room v8       = new Room( "in an empty street with beatiful buildings", "Road2.png" );
057        Room v9       = new Room( textMonster, "Monster3.png" );
058        Room v10      = new Room( textKey, "Chest2.png" );
059        Room vVictory = new Room( "in the tower you wanted to find for so long", "LightHouse.png" );
060
061        vStart.setExits( "down", v3 );
062        v2.setExits( "east", v3 );
063        v2.setExits( "south", v5 );
064        v3.setExits( "east", v4 );
065        v3.setExits( "south", v6 );
066        v3.setExits( "west", v2 );
067        v4.setExits( "south", v7 );
068        v4.setExits( "west", v3 );
069        v5.setExits( "north", v2 );
070        v6.setExits( "north", v3 );
071        v6.setExits( "east", v7 );
072        v6.setExits( "south", v8 );
073        v7.setExits( "west", v6 );
074        v8.setExits( "north", v6 );
075        v8.setExits( "up", vVictory );
076        v8.setExits( "south", v9 );
077        v9.setExits( "north", v8 );
078        v9.setExits( "south", v10 );
079        v10.setExits( "north", v9 );
080        vVictory.setExits( "down", v8 );
081
082        // création du joueur avec un poids maximum de 10kg
083        this.aPlayer = new Player( "Hero", vStart, 10.0 );
084
085        // création des items
086        Item vFins      = new Item( "Fins",      "a pair of perfectly fine diving fins, maybe it could help you move around the city", 1.0 );
087        Item vKey1      = new Item( "Key1",      "a mysterious key, it seems like it could open a door", 0.1 );
088        Item vKey2      = new Item( "Key2",      "a mysterious key, it seems like it could open the lighthouse door", 0.1 );
089        Item vBottle    = new Item( "Bottle",    "a marvelous bottle of oxygen", 2.0 );
090        Item vTelescope = new Item( "Telescope", "a beautiful telescope in which you could see the whole city", 5.0 );
091        Item vTrash     = new Item( "Trash",     "just some useless trash sitting next to the key", 10.0 );
092        Item vCookie    = new Item( "Cookie",    "a magic cookie, it looks delicious", 0.1 );
093        Item vBeamer    = new Beamer( "Beamer",  "a mysterious teleportation device", 1.0 );
094
095        // placement des items dans les pièces
096        vStart.addItem( vTelescope );
097        v3.addItem( vCookie );
098        v3.addItem( vBottle );
099        v5.addItem( vFins );
100        v7.addItem( vTrash );
101        v7.addItem( vKey1 );
102        v10.addItem( vKey2 );
103        v2.addItem( vBeamer );
104
105        // portes verrouillées
106        Door vDoor1 = new Door( v3, v6, "Key1" );
107        v3.addDoor( vDoor1 );
108        v6.addDoor( vDoor1 );
109
110        Door vDoor2 = new Door( v8, vVictory, "Key2" );
111        v8.addDoor( vDoor2 );
112        vVictory.addDoor( vDoor2 );
113
114        this.aVictoryRoom = vVictory;
115
116        // création du randomizer et ajout des pièces accessibles par téléportation
117        this.aRandomizer = new RoomRandomizer();
118        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "vStart", vStart );
119        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v2",     v2 );
120        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v3",     v3 );
121        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v4",     v4 );
122        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v5",     v5 );
123        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v6",     v6 );
124        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v7",     v7 );
125        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v8",     v8 );
126        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v9",     v9 );
127        this.aRandomizer.addRoom( "v10",    v10 );
128
129        // création et connexion de la pièce téléporteur
130        TransporterRoom vTransporter = new TransporterRoom( "in a strange glowing room", "Transporter.png", this.aRandomizer );
131        v2.setExits( "north", vTransporter );
132        vTransporter.setExits( "south", v2 );
133        
134        // création des monstre 
135        v4.setMonster( true );
136        v6.setMonster( true );
137        v9.setMonster( true );
138    }

140    /**
141     * Tente de déplacer le joueur dans la direction indiquée.
142     * Vérifie les portes verrouillées, l'oxygène et la condition de victoire.
143     */
144    private void goRoom( final Command pCommand )
145    {
146        if ( !pCommand.hasSecondWord() ) {
147            this.aGui.println( "Go where?" );
148            return;
149        }
150
151        String vDirection = pCommand.getSecondWord();
152        Room vNextRoom = this.aPlayer.getCurrentRoom().getExitIgnoreDoors( vDirection );
153        if ( vNextRoom == null ) {
154            this.aGui.println( "There is no door!" );
155            return;
156        }
157
158        // vérification de la porte verrouillée
159        Door vDoor = this.aPlayer.getCurrentRoom().getLockedDoor( vNextRoom );
160        if ( vDoor != null ) {
161            this.aGui.println( "This door is locked! Find the right key and use 'unlock'." );
162            return;
163        }
164
165        // vérification de l'oxygène
166        if ( this.aPlayer.decrementMoves() ) {
167            this.aGui.println( "You ran out of oxygen... Game over." );
168            this.aGui.enable( false );
169            return;
170        } else {
171            this.aGui.println( "Oxygen left: " + this.aPlayer.getMovesLeft() + " moves." );
172        }
173
174        this.aPlayer.goRoom( vNextRoom );
175        this.printLocationInfo();
176
177        // vérification de la victoire
178        if ( this.aPlayer.getCurrentRoom() == this.aVictoryRoom ) {
179            this.aGui.println( "Congratulations! You found the tower and mapped the city! You win!" );
180            this.aGui.enable( false );
181        }
182        
183        // vérification si la pièce contient un monstre
184        if ( this.aPlayer.getCurrentRoom().hasMonster() ) {
185            this.aGui.println( this.aPlayer.monsterPenalty() );
186        }
187    }

225    /**
226     * Retourne le joueur dans la pièce précédente.
227     * Distingue le cas du début du jeu et celui d'une trap door.
228     */
229    private void goBack()
230    {
231        Room vPrevious = this.aPlayer.goBack();
232        if ( vPrevious == null ) {
233            if ( this.aPlayer.isPreviousRoomsEmpty() ) {
234                this.aGui.println( "You can't go back, you are at the beginning!" );
235            } else {
236                this.aGui.println( "You can't go back, there is a trap door!" );
237            }
238            return;
239        }
240        this.printLocationInfo();
241    }

267    /**
268     * Termine le jeu en désactivant l'interface.
269     */

271    {
272        if ( pCommand.hasSecondWord() ) {
273            this.aGui.println( "Quit what?" );
274            return false;

277            this.aGui.enable( false );

282    /**
283     * Lit un fichier texte et exécute chaque ligne comme une commande.
284     * Active le mode test pendant l'exécution pour autoriser la commande alea.
285     */
286    private void test( final Command pCommand )
287    {
288        if ( !pCommand.hasSecondWord() ) {
289            this.aGui.println( "Test which file?" );
290            return;
291        }
292        String vFileName = pCommand.getSecondWord() + ".txt";
293        try {
294            this.aTestMode = true; // activation du mode test
295            Scanner vScanner = new Scanner( new File( vFileName ) );
296            while ( vScanner.hasNextLine() ) {
297                String vLine = vScanner.nextLine();
298                this.interpretCommand( vLine );
299            }
300            vScanner.close();
301            this.aTestMode = false; // désactivation du mode test
302        } catch ( FileNotFoundException e ) {
303            this.aGui.println( "File not found: " + vFileName );
304            this.aTestMode = false;
305        }
306    }

333    /**
334     * Commande alea : force ou libère le prochain tirage aléatoire.
335     * Disponible uniquement en mode test.
336     */
337    private void alea( final Command pCommand )
338    {
339        if ( !this.aTestMode ) {
340            this.aGui.println( "This command is only available in test mode!" );
341            return;
342        }
343        if ( pCommand.hasSecondWord() ) {
344            Room vRoom = this.findRoom( pCommand.getSecondWord() );
345            if ( vRoom == null ) {
346                this.aGui.println( "Unknown room: " + pCommand.getSecondWord() );
347                return;
348            }
349            this.aRandomizer.setForcedRoom( vRoom );
350            this.aGui.println( "Teleportation forced to: " + vRoom.getDescription() );
351        } else {
352            this.aRandomizer.clearForcedRoom();
353            this.aGui.println( "Teleportation is now truly random." );
354        }
355    }

357    /**
358     * Retourne la pièce correspondant à l'identifiant donné via le randomizer.
359     */
360    private Room findRoom( final String pRoomId )
361    {
362        return this.aRandomizer.getRoom( pRoomId );
363    }

365    /**
366     * Analyse et exécute la commande tapée par le joueur.
367     */
368    public void interpretCommand( final String pCommandLine )
369    {
370        this.aGui.println( "> " + pCommandLine );
371        Command vCommand = this.aParser.getCommand( pCommandLine );
372
373        if ( vCommand.isUnknown() ) {
374            this.aGui.println( "I don't know what you mean..." );
375            return;
376        }
377
378        String vCommandWord = vCommand.getCommandWord();
379        if ( vCommandWord.equals( "help" ) ) {
380            this.printHelp();
381        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "go" ) ) {
382            this.goRoom( vCommand );
383        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "look" ) ) {
384            if ( vCommand.hasSecondWord() ) {
385                this.aGui.println( "Look what? This command has no second word!" );
386            } else {
387                this.printLocationInfo();
388            }
389        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "back" ) ) {
390            if ( vCommand.hasSecondWord() ) {
391                this.aGui.println( "Back what? This command has no second word!" );
392            } else {
393                this.goBack();
394            }
395        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "eat" ) ) {
396            if ( vCommand.hasSecondWord() ) {
397                this.aGui.println( this.aPlayer.eatItem( vCommand.getSecondWord() ) );
398            } else {
399                this.aGui.println( "Eat what?" );
400            }
401        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "test" ) ) {
402            this.test( vCommand );
403        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "take" ) ) {
404            this.takeItem( vCommand );
405        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "drop" ) ) {
406            this.dropItem( vCommand );
407        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "items" ) ) {
408            this.aGui.println( this.aPlayer.getCarriedItemsString() );
409        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "quit" ) ) {
410            this.quit( vCommand );
411        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "charge" ) ) {
412            this.chargeBeamer( vCommand );
413        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "fire" ) ) {
414            this.fireBeamer( vCommand );
415        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "unlock" ) ) {
416            this.unlockDoor( vCommand );
417        } else if ( vCommandWord.equals( "alea" ) ) {
418            this.alea( vCommand );
419        }
420    }
